facts.fact: Finnfund, the Finnish development finance institution, made a follow-on investment of USD 5 million in Communication & Renewable Energy Infrastructure (CREI), bringing its total in the company to USD 10 million, to finance solar-hybrid power for over 500 MTN South Sudan telecom sites; the document gives no signing date, so the date is its publication date (19 February 2026).
facts.system: Finnfund follow-on investment in CREI, South Sudan solar-hybrid telecom sites
